d:
Watch Yennamma Ippadi Panreengalaema from Rajinimurugan sung by D.Imman and written by Yugabharathi. This song about love failure is catchy with simple lyrics & a peppy tone.
Song Name - Yennamma Ippadi Panreengalaema
Movie - Rajinimurugan
Singer - D. Imman
Music - D. Imman
Lyrics - Yugabharathi
Director - Ponram
Starring - Sivakarthikeyan, Keerthi Suresh
